lines.text: Moses anointed the tabernacle, and the tribal leaders brought six covered carts and twelve oxen before it.
Moses gave the Gershonites two carts and four oxen, and the Merarites four carts and eight oxen under Eleazar.
Moses gave no carts to the Kohathites, since they were to carry the holy objects on their shoulders.
The LORD told Moses that one leader would present his offering each week, and Nahshon of Judah went first.
When Moses entered the Tent of Meeting, he heard the voice speaking from above the mercy seat on the ark.
